throughline.zh: 本週聚焦 AI 投資如何穿過算力、融資、授權、資安與能源限制，台歐合作也提出新的供應鏈方向。
throughline.en: This week tracks AI investment through compute, funding, licensing, security and energy constraints, alongside proposed Taiwan-Europe supply-chain cooperation.

title.zh: AI 晶片競爭轉向整套系統成本
title.en: AI-chip competition shifts toward system cost

summary.zh: 微軟 Maia 300 與 Scaleway 北歐布局增加算力選擇，Scaleway 同時採用 AMD 與 NVIDIA。效能宣稱、可用容量及商用時程仍需驗證。
summary.en: Microsoft Maia 300 and Scaleway's Northern Europe plans expand compute options; Scaleway uses both AMD and NVIDIA. Performance claims, capacity and availability still require verification.

title.zh: DRAM 漲價推高南亞科獲利

summary.zh: 南亞科第三季自結毛利率達 85.7%，但出貨量下降。這次成長主要看價格，後續要追蹤供給、庫存與漲價能否延續。
summary.en: Nanya reported a preliminary Q3 gross margin of 85.7% despite lower shipments. Pricing matters more than volume; watch supply, inventories and price durability.

title.zh: 晶片供應鏈同時面對授權與製程門檻
title.en: Chip supply chains face licensing and process constraints

summary.zh: USITC 供電調查與玻璃核心驗證尚未有最終結果；Arm 案判名目賠償 2 美元，權利金爭議仍未結。程序進展與實際供應、成本影響需分開看。
summary.en: Power-delivery proceedings and glass-core validation remain unresolved; the Arm case awarded $2 while royalties remain pending. Procedural progress does not establish supply or cost effects.

title.zh: Agent 商用與資安要同步評估

summary.zh: HCLTech 與 Anthropic 合作、IonQ 洽購 Elisity 推進企業導入與安全布局。Anthropic 複製研究使用簡化網路，無法直接認定真實網路已出現自主擴散。
summary.en: HCLTech's Anthropic partnership and IonQ's signed Elisity deal address adoption and security. Anthropic's simplified replication tests do not establish autonomous real-world propagation.

title.zh: AI 融資熱度與總體風險並存
title.en: AI financing coexists with macroeconomic risk

summary.zh: IMF 上修 2026 年成長預測至 3.1%，騰訊發債約 57 億美元。預測受能源假設影響，發債也增加償債義務，兩者都無法保證 AI 投資回報。
summary.en: The IMF raised 2026 growth to 3.1%; Tencent raised about $5.7 billion in debt. Forecasts depend on energy assumptions, while borrowing adds obligations; neither guarantees AI returns.

title.zh: 能源安全牽動出口路徑與危機融資
title.en: Energy security affects export routes and crisis financing

summary.zh: 沙國規劃管線擴容，OPEC 資料顯示 9 月增產；世銀討論危機援助。產量、出口、到岸供應與核准撥款各有不同進度，能源恢復仍需實際數據。
summary.en: Saudi pipeline expansion is planned, OPEC data show September output recovery, and the World Bank discusses aid. Production, exports, delivered supply and disbursements progress separately.

title.zh: 台灣外交與台歐產業合作增加新動向
title.en: Taiwan diplomacy and European cooperation develop

summary.zh: 中國制裁邦交國官員後，美方提出反對；林佳龍在華沙倡議台歐高科技合作。外交立場與產業計畫尚未等同具體經貿損益或完成投資。
summary.en: The US opposed sanctions on Taiwan allies' officials, while Lin proposed high-tech cooperation in Warsaw. Diplomatic positions and proposals do not establish trade effects or completed investment.
